dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region to a sharp posterior point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical outward curvature on the right lateral margin compared to the more linear left margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Extensive mottling consisting of medium-frequency dark grey patches distributed across the dorsal surface, with higher density on the right side.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the pigmented mottled clusters and the lighter baseline skin.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint linear rake marks visible as low-contrast parallel lines across the mid-dorsal area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple linear rake marks or scratches visible across the dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent longitudinal dorsal ridge visible along the central axis.
